consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at The Ark on April 21, 1969, highlighting the energy and tightness of the band throughout the show. The second set, particularly the Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven sequence, is frequently mentioned as a standout moment, showcasing the band's improvisational prowess.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 65 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The majority of reviews express high enthusiasm for the performance, with many calling it one of the best shows of 1969, leading to a significant positive adjustment from the neutral baseline.
